title: hieracium pilosella subsp. impexum
intro: Hieracium pilosella subsp. impexum, commonly known as a subspecies of the Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including inflammation, skin conditions, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pilosella subsp. impexum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
